method.name: Command TF-IDF + artifact containment
method.score: 0.45 × command TF-IDF similarity + 0.55 × training-IDF-weighted containment of distinctive artifact-name tokens in the shorter trace
method.threshold_selection: Select the cutoff from inner task-grouped out-of-fold predictions within each outer fold; the selected score was artifact containment plus command TF-IDF in all three folds.

dataset.label_scope: Same benchmark-qualified CTF task as a retrieval proxy, not actor, campaign, organization, or identity.
dataset.reuse_boundary: Task groups were used during method development; results are exploratory and not independent confirmation.

zero_miss_sensitivity.interpretation: Independent-task-cluster sensitivity bound for the share of task groups with any missed link; not a confidence interval for task-macro false-split rate.

limits: The 75.87% false-merge rate remains too high for attribution.
Human terminal records and Agent tool-call records use different collection interfaces, so execution mode is confounded with capture format.
The dataset has no Script traces or independent actor, campaign, or organization labels.
